_readme: Google review snapshot. Update these values from the live Google Business listing, then run: node src/build.mjs. Only add reviews that appear on the listing, copied exactly. Show reviewer names as initials only. 'time' is the relative time as Google showed it on 'capturedOn'.

breakdown._note: total and average from the Google listing. counts = number of reviews per star rating. CURRENT COUNTS ARE ESTIMATES (set 18 Oct 2026): replace with the exact counts from the Google listing. null = not entered (bar stays empty and shows a dash). Bar width = count / largest count.

_mapNote: Google Maps place links cannot be shown inside an iframe, so the map uses Google's embed form of the same place (name + coordinates from the listing). To use Google's own embed code instead: Google Maps > Share > Embed a map > copy the src URL here.

reviews.text: Good treatment, I got my 3 wisdom teeth removed and cured in just a very short span would definitely recommend

I am currently undergoing braces treatment at Sree Mithra Dental Specialists, and my experience has been excellent. My orthodontist visits from Bangalore to provide treatment at this clinic, and I am very satisfied with the care. The doctor is highly skilled, explains every procedure clearly, and is very patient. The clinic is clean, well-maintained, and the staff is friendly and supportive. Appointments are well organized, and I feel confident about my treatment. I highly recommend Sree Mithra Dental Specialists for quality dental care and orthodontic (braces) treatment.
